title: Top Democrat among Senate investigators probes ties between Cantor Fitzgerald, Tether
summary: As Democrats steadily rise in their potential to take back a Senate majority, Senator Richard Blumenthal is digging into Tether's U.S. financial partnership.

title: Wall Street's tokenization boom could have bigger winners than bitcoin and ether, Citrini says
summary: The research firm sees tokenized stocks, bonds and loans creating new markets for trading and lending, with fee-generating platforms and companies poised to benefit.

title: Crypto crumbles as anniversary of flash crash nears
summary: It was October 10, 2025, when bitcoin plunged from about $122,000 to $105,000, with much of the decline occurring within minutes.

title: NFL joins pushback against prediction markets as U.S. Supreme Court asked to act
summary: In opposition to federal oversight of the prediction markets, the National Football League has sided with states, Gary Gensler and one of the authors of the relevant law.

title: U.S. government moves $1 billion in bitcoin tied to Bitfinex hack, with no sign of sale
summary: Arkham data shows the 12,267 BTC went to unlabeled wallets rather than an exchange, a day after $383 million hit Coinbase Prime.
